content: Nzmncngr Kx Abrtzlvz Gct

Mzlegrng x inwegrng, alvztrpekr nimu mz nzmncngr kxtubq, murde na-aelalz-ngrm drtwr Gct, x sc tqvz-nqblqpeamu. X mzli ka rngidrtx-zlwz-ngrbzkr bamu mz zmatq ngr Kxetu rgu Jiszs, kx nzmnc-krmu lc tqtubq navz zvz x naetunepx.
Krlzpeamu nike pibzkr bamu, mz zmatq ngr Kxetu rgu Jiszs.
Me pnz drtwr Gct nide sele: Nzmnc-krmu natramu, x nayrlqpx-lzbqamu mz alwx ngr nzrmwimi-krmu doa kxtrngiu krnalzmu.
Suti drtwrde kx doa kxesz' mz nimu nakrlzle nzaclve-krde nrkrdrtqde mz nzmncngr kxtr x kxtubq.
Leplz kcng trnzkrlzlru Gct nzrlrpx-ngrdr nrkrdrtqdr nzmailz-krdr nidr mz alwx ngr nzrmwimingr doa kxtrngiu krnalzdr. A' bzkq apuamu nidr.
X bzkq angqngutiamu kztemu mz da lc. Murde Gct sa na-ayrplapx-zlwzle leplz kx nzrtrngztibzlr da lcng. Dekc tqpi-ngrbzkrle ena bamu mz natq kxlqlwx.
Gct kqlele nigu murde nzmnc-krgu natr. X trsutiu drtwrde nzrtrngzti-krbzku alwx ngr nzrmwimingr kxtrngiu krnalzgu.
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, mrlx kx pxtxpx-ngrde nzalvztrngr lc, pxtxpx-kz-ngrde Gct, kc tqrkam bagu Mqngrkxtr.
Tryrpwzkru kxnamu nzmrlzti-krmu kztemung mz Kraes, murde opx angidr kx Gct alvztrpe-ngrde nimu da lc.
Murde mrlztiamu leplz neng Kraes mz mztea amrlx mrkc Masedonia Provins. A' mzli ka, rngidrtr-ngrbzkr bamu kx nzmrlzti-krmu nidr naetunepx zvz.
Rtrngztibzmu da kc tqbatrpzle nzmnc-krmu mz nrwx. Bzkq pnz drtwrmu dztu leplz, a' dztumu. X aleamu nzwz-krmu esz'-krmu. Pi-pnzbzkr bamu ena nzale-krmu da lcng.
Murde mz nzmnc-krmu lc tqmrlz, leplz kcng trnzlxngitilru Kraes na-amatqlr nimu x ma tqmnc-xgleamu doa kc-kzng.
Nzyzlu-krm Kxetu Rgu
Suti drtwrgr nakrlzamu nike naprtzbz mz leplz neng Kraes kcng tzbzpeng. Murde trsutiu drtwrgr nzmnc-krmu mz drtwr kxvz mz nzapu-krmu leplz kx trpnzngr da kx nzobqtipxlr.
Lxngitiku kx Jiszs bz x tulz mou. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, Gct sa na-atulz-kzple krkcng tzbzpeng tzlxngitilr Jiszs, murde navzmimle nidr, mzli kc nayzlu-ngrmle.
Nzalvztrkr Kxetu nide sele. Nigu kcng tzlubeng mzli kc nayzlu-ngrm Kxetu rgu, trnartwayzpwzkuu mz krkcng tzbzpeng, mz nzvzdz-ngrbz mz nzrmctingr nide.
Murde mzli kc Kxetu rgu navzom Heven, lr nrlc sa naxlrlr dq nzkabongr, natq narenjrl, x trpu r nzkqkr Gct. X leplz neng Kraes kx nzbzpeng natulz-kaipqng.
X mz nibrde, nigu kcng tzlubeng x kxnzlu-moung sa navzdz-lxblrku mz nabz dcbz, mz nzyrlwrpx-lxblr-krgu badr Kxetu mrlc mzlilxlr. X sa namnc-lxblr-aloku badr Kxetu!
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, apqtr-etramu nabzmu mz nzpipx-krmu natq lcng.
